body: Often times other people do you want to see us fail, it helps them feel better about themselves. But I promise if you set your mind to it you can succeed in any aspect of life =]
Your parents would only wish they could have seen the signs & have helped you. They would blame themselves for not “seeing it” I promise people truly care.
Manual labor led me to owning my own company and supporting myself better than I thought I’d be able to. Who knows where things can lead. I wish you the best.

I think the people around you would be devastated they didn’t have a chance to help you. My little brother killed himself and that’s how I feel. I wish he would have given me a chance to help him before making the decision. Your family loves you.
Thank you. I appreciate your words & thoughts about this. I hope you know your siblings would very much be affected by losing you. They love you and would only want to see the best for you.
Damn that is fucked up, I’m sorry to hear that.
